rows.text: when bit 0 of byte `rcx+0x57E` is set, makes the call at `002BE290` + 0x12 with `rcx` and, when that returns non-null, the call at + 0x22 with (`rcx`, that result); then, when qword `rcx+0x570` is non-null and its word `+0x280` has bit 0 clear and bit 2 set, makes the call at + 0x42 with that qword, zeroes qword `rcx+0x570` and clears bit 1 of word `rcx+0x57E` (AND `0xfffd`); otherwise returns without further writes

notes: 002BE290: the bit-0 test reads byte +0x57E; the final clear writes word +0x57E.
